zh.title: 長榮、ANA全日空星空聯盟彩繪機同框　松山機場分享機坪畫面
zh.summary: 松山機場官方Facebook粉絲團分享長榮航空與ANA全日空兩架星空聯盟彩繪機同時現身的照片，兩機分列航廈兩側，黑色機尾與機身上的聯盟字樣一同入鏡。
body: 臺北松山機場（TSA）官方Facebook粉絲團10月24日發布機坪照片，分享長榮航空與ANA全日空兩架星空聯盟彩繪機同時現身的畫面。官方以「兩架星空聯盟彩繪機」介紹這次同框，並點名兩家航空公司。
照片中，兩架客機分列航廈兩側，機尾均採黑色底色搭配星空聯盟標誌，機身則可見「STAR ALLIANCE」字樣。陰雲下的機坪地面映出航機與航廈倒影，呈現兩家航空公司聯盟塗裝同場的景象。
這則貼文聚焦兩架彩繪機的同框畫面，未列出航班編號、航機註冊號或後續派遣安排。

en.title: EVA Air and ANA Star Alliance-Liveried Aircraft Share the Apron at Taipei Songshan
en.summary: Taipei Songshan Airport shared a photograph of EVA Air and ANA aircraft in Star Alliance livery parked on opposite sides of its terminal.
body: Taipei Songshan Airport (TSA) shared an apron photograph on its official Facebook page on October 24, showing two Star Alliance-liveried aircraft together. The airport identified the airlines as EVA Air and ANA.

The aircraft are parked on opposite sides of the terminal, both displaying black tails with the Star Alliance emblem and STAR ALLIANCE lettering on their fuselages. The wet apron reflects the aircraft and terminal beneath an overcast sky.
The post focuses on the two aircraft appearing together and does not specify flight numbers, registrations or subsequent assignments.
